mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad consumer spending weakness that reduces corporate revenue visibility, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative S&P 500 returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing contraction (INDPRO < 98.0), industrial output decline signals reduced corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 98.0, or Rank IC for INDPRO signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5% for three consecutive months, it triggers hawkish monetary policy expectations that increase real interest rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the past six months indicates strong consumer confidence and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises over the prior 6 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary labor market regime (PAYEMS annual growth < 0.5%), reduced employment growth signals declining consumer spending and corporate profit pressures, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS annual growth < 0.5%, or Rank IC for PAYEMS signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and persistent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% fails to predict negative S&P 500 returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
